captions.detailed: This 3D model is a modular connector block, featuring a hollow square column with thick walls. It has integrated male dovetail joints on its outer sides, allowing multiple blocks to slide together and lock. The top and bottom of the block are completely open, and the outer edges of the walls feature a subtle bevel detail.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric modular connector block in OpenSCAD with options for different connector configurations on each side (such as 4-way, 3-way, or 2-way). The user should be able to adjust parameters like the square size, wall thickness, block depth, connector clearance, and whether to include a back wall or a decorative bevel.
captions.factory: The script defines several 2D polygon profiles representing the outer connector shapes (e.g., square, square1B, square2A) and their corresponding inner cutouts (offSquare, offSquare1B). The main 3D geometry is generated using linear_extrude on the selected outer shape scaled by grid_size, and then a difference() operation subtracts the extruded inner offset shape. An additional cuttingGrid() module, constructed using rotated and translated polygon extrusions, creates the optional bevel details on the outer corners.
